CHFA-CMF.name: CHFA Capital Magnet Fund
CHFA-CMF.description: CHFA flexible gap financing for eligible 4% or 9% Housing Tax Credit developments. CHFA announced a $4.5 million federal CMF award on November 7, 2024; that award is not a current available balance.
restrictions: CHFA need not be senior lender for the main loan; the optional 20% structure requires CHFA senior financing.

max_rule.text: Up to $750,000 per project; up to 20% may be deferred or granted when CHFA is senior lender, subject to CHFA clarification.

CHFA-CMF.source_note: Main loan requires monthly principal and interest. No numeric rate_pct or uncommitted balance is published. CHFA pages disagree on the optional 20% when CHFA is senior lender: the CMF FAQ says a deferred no-interest loan, while the small-loan comparison says a grant. Confirm that portion with CHFA; do not classify the whole loan as a grant. The 17-year term comes from both pages.

HOME-CO.description: Federal HOME assistance through DOH for eligible rental acquisition, rehabilitation and construction. Award-specific terms must be obtained from DOH.

DOH-HDG.name: DOH Housing Development Grant
DOH-HDG.description: DOH Housing Development Grant Funds can be awarded as grants or loans for acquisition, rehabilitation and construction. Use the award-specific terms.
DOH-HDG.source_note: The official page offers grants or loans; funding_type and repayment are not one universal structure. Loan rates are generally 2% for for-profits and 1% for nonprofits, with terms tied to senior debt and repayment from cash flow or up to 40-year amortization. A single rate_pct or term_years would be misleading, so each is null. No program-wide project cap, round deadline or available balance is stated.

NHTF-CO.name: National Housing Trust Fund (Colorado)
NHTF-CO.description: Federal National Housing Trust Fund assistance administered by Colorado DOH for extremely low-income rental housing; grants or loans depend on the award.
NHTF-CO.source_note: The DOH page identifies rental housing with all DOH-assisted units at 30% AMI or less, and awards as grants or loans. A single funding_type, rate_pct, term_years, repayment, project cap and available balance are not stated and remain null.

PROP123-AHTF.name: Proposition 123 Affordable Housing Fund
PROP123-AHTF.description: Proposition 123's State Affordable Housing Fund is split: 60% is overseen by OEDIT and managed by CHFA (the Affordable Housing Financing Fund), and 40% goes to DOLA (the Affordable Housing Support Fund). Rental gap finance, equity and land banking have separate records and award terms. This umbrella entry is not an additional source to sum.
PROP123-AHTF.note: See PROP123-LIHTC-GAP, PROP123-EQUITY and PROP123-LBTF for the distinct instruments.
PROP123-AHTF.source_note: Umbrella record, not an additional financing source. It contains multiple instruments, so funding_type, rate_pct, term_years, repayment and max_rule are null. See the separate LIHTC gap, equity and land-banking records. No remaining balance is published on the program pages.

PROP123-LBTF.name: Prop 123 Land Banking Trust Fund
PROP123-LBTF.description: Prop 123 land acquisition and preservation through grants to eligible governments or forgivable loans to eligible nonprofits.
restrictions: Rural and Rural Resort applications: September 15 through December 31, 2026, or until funds are exhausted; all geographies from January 2027.
Jurisdiction must have a Proposition 123 affordable-housing commitment.
Land acquisition, not construction gap financing.

max_rule.text: Lesser of $5,000,000 or CHFA concluded appraised value.

PROP123-LBTF.source_note: Grants serve local/tribal governments; forgivable loans serve nonprofits. There is no single funding_type, rate_pct, term_years or repayment for both, so these scalars are null. Nonprofit loans accrue 2% deferred interest, waived if milestones are met: zoning/development plan within 5 years and permits/funding within 10. Missed milestones trigger repayment within six months. The cap is also limited to CHFA appraised value. The FY27 allocation is not an uncommitted balance.

PAB-CO.name: Private Activity Bond Volume Cap (Colorado)
PAB-CO.description: Private Activity Bond volume-cap context. Allocation authority is separate from the actual project bond loan; confirm current availability and qualification with the allocating authority.
PAB-CO.source_note: Volume-cap allocation is borrowing authority, not itself a loan or cash grant. funding_type, rate_pct, term_years, repayment and max_rule are therefore null; bond terms come from a separate financing. The page does not give this listing a verified remaining allocation balance.

OZ-EQUITY.name: Opportunity Zone Equity Investment
OZ-EQUITY.description: Qualified Opportunity Zone (QOZ) capital gains deferral incentive under IRC §1400Z-2. Projects in designated OZ census tracts can attract equity from investors seeking capital gains tax deferral. Can be layered with LIHTC but complex structuring required. Not a direct funding program — availability depends on investor market.
OZ-EQUITY.note: 2018 OZ designations remain relevant through 12/31/2028; OZ 2.0 creates decennial designation rounds beginning with the 2026-07-01 determination date. Rural sites should diligence whether a Qualified Rural Opportunity Fund structure applies; Public Law 119-21 §70421 adds a 30% five-year basis step-up for qualifying rural QROF investments. Projects must be in designated OZ tracts (see QCT/DDA overlay).
OZ-EQUITY.source_note: The CDFI page describes the Opportunity Zone designation and investor tax incentive. It does not state a universal investor rate_pct, term_years, repayment schedule, project cap or available balance. Those terms depend on private investment agreements; null does not mean free capital.

NMTC-CO.name: New Markets Tax Credits (Colorado CDEs)
NMTC-CO.description: NMTC supports qualifying investments through Community Development Entities. Obtain CDE-specific financing terms and confirm rental/mixed-use eligibility; no universal rental project award is assumed.
NMTC-CO.note: NMTC + LIHTC dual structures are rare but possible for mixed-use developments with commercial components.
NMTC-CO.source_note: CDFI describes tax credits for investments into CDEs, not one standardized rental-project financing instrument. funding_type, rate_pct, term_years, repayment and max_rule are null for the downstream project. The seven-year tax-credit period is not a loan term. No universal project maximum or available balance is published.

TIF-LOCAL.name: Tax Increment Financing (Local)
TIF-LOCAL.description: Municipal TIF districts can provide gap financing for affordable housing through property tax increment capture. Availability varies by municipality — Denver, Aurora, Colorado Springs, Lakewood, and Fort Collins have active URA/TIF programs. Requires municipal approval and urban renewal authority designation.
TIF-LOCAL.note: Check with local urban renewal authority for active TIF districts. Not all municipalities have enabling legislation.
TIF-LOCAL.source_note: The official act describes tax-increment financing authority, not an award to this project. Local agreements determine funding_type, rate_pct, term_years, repayment and max_rule; all are null without an adopted agreement. No statewide project cap or available balance is stated.

CEO-WAP.name: Weatherization Assistance Program (Colorado / DOE WAP)
CEO-WAP.description: Income-qualified weatherization services administered through state and local WAP providers. DOE guidance confirms WAP is state/local administered and open to eligible homeowners and renters; no universal Colorado project-dollar amount is published for underwriting.
CEO-WAP.adminEntity: DOE / Colorado Energy Office / local WAP providers
CEO-WAP.source_note: Primary source reopened 2026-10-09. DOE WAP pages previously checked 2026-07-18; Program Year 2026 guidance is published, but household/project awards vary by local provider. DOE describes delivered weatherization services, not one project-financing instrument. funding_type, rate_pct, term_years, repayment and max_rule are null: no universal rental-project terms or cap are stated.
CEO-WAP.warning: Screening context only. Verify local provider eligibility, landlord permission for renters, and current provider capacity before advising a household or underwriting a rehab scope.

CEO-IRA-HOME-ENERGY-REBATES.name: Colorado Home Energy Rebates (HEAR / HOMES)
CEO-IRA-HOME-ENERGY-REBATES.description: DOE describes Home Energy Rebates as state-administered and available only in select jurisdictions. Colorado launch materials say HEAR began through WAP with broader direct-consumer and multifamily HOMES phases planned; current Colorado availability could not be fetch-verified on an accessible official CEO page this session.
CEO-IRA-HOME-ENERGY-REBATES.source_note: Primary source reopened 2026-10-09. DOE program page previously checked 2026-07-18; Colorado CEO status page was blocked by CDN/WAF, so this entry remains VERIFY rather than active. DOE describes rebates rather than one of the loan/equity instruments. funding_type, rate_pct, term_years and repayment are null. Federal household examples ($8,000 HOMES and $14,000 HEEHR) are not a verified Colorado multifamily project maximum, so max_rule remains null.
CEO-IRA-HOME-ENERGY-REBATES.warning: VERIFY before use. Federal IRA rebate implementation is volatile and Colorado phase availability was not independently confirmed on an accessible current official state page.

CEO-BUILDING-ELECTRIFICATION-GRANTS.name: CEO building electrification / high-efficiency heating grants
CEO-BUILDING-ELECTRIFICATION-GRANTS.description: Colorado HB22-1362 created CEO-administered building electrification and high-efficiency electric heating/appliance grant authority for eligible entities including housing developers. Current open-round dollars were not fetch-verified on an accessible official CEO page this session.
CEO-BUILDING-ELECTRIFICATION-GRANTS.source_note: Primary source reopened 2026-10-09. CEO-LBD-SHOWCASE.name: Large Building Decarbonization Showcase Grant Program
CEO-LBD-SHOWCASE.description: Colorado announced a first 2026 LBD Showcase award round for large-building efficiency and electrification projects, including affordable senior housing, and anticipated another implementation round in summer 2026. Current remaining funds and application window require program-page verification.
CEO-LBD-SHOWCASE.source_note: Official Governor/CEO release and CDPHE Building Performance Standards page verified 2026-07-18. The previously cited release could not be re-opened on 2026-10-09 (HTTP 403). No new funding_type, rate_pct, term_years, repayment or max_rule is verified; each remains null. Prior verification date is retained, not advanced.
CEO-LBD-SHOWCASE.warning: Context only. Verify current LBD NOFA status and project eligibility before assuming availability.

PROP123-LIHTC-GAP.name: Proposition 123 LIHTC Gap Finance
PROP123-LIHTC-GAP.description: Subordinate financing for developments awarded federal LIHTC that have not converted to permanent financing. Amortizing or non-amortizing structures depend on underwriting.

max_rule.text: Least of the loan supported at 1.05x DSCR on all must-pay debt, 10% of total project cost, or $6,000,000; minimum $400,000.

PROP123-LIHTC-GAP.source_note: Fixed rate is 2.5%. The page offers amortizing and non-amortizing structures without selecting one funding_type or repayment schedule; these are null until underwriting. term_years is not published; the greater-of-loan-term-or-30-years affordability covenant is not a stated loan term. The last application window was May 27–June 10, 2026 and is closed. Available, awarded and capacity balances for this instrument are not stated.
restrictions: Restricted units average no more than 60% AMI.
Up to 25% of units may be unrestricted, but are excluded from eligible financing.
A jurisdiction affordable-housing commitment is required.

PROP123-EQUITY.name: Proposition 123 Equity
PROP123-EQUITY.description: Equity with returns from available cash flow and principal repayment deferred to a capital event or sale. Cannot be combined with federal or state Housing Tax Credit equity.

max_rule.text: Investment between $1,500,000 and $15,000,000, subject to project evaluation and available program funding.

PROP123-EQUITY.source_note: Below-market returns are cash-flow dependent; no numeric rate_pct is stated. Principal is deferred to a capital event or sale; the investment term is up to 30 years. The 1% servicing charge is a share of available cash flow, not an interest rate. No current uncommitted balance is published. Last applications closed February 26, 2026.
restrictions: Cannot pair with federal or state Housing Tax Credit equity.
Restricted units average no more than 90% AMI.

CHFA-HOF.name: CHFA Housing Opportunity Fund
CHFA-HOF.description: Must-pay CHFA financing that can also support interest costs on CHFA senior debt. CHFA must be senior lender.
CHFA-HOF.source_note: Main loan requires monthly principal and interest, normally a 30-year term; longer terms are case-by-case. HOF may instead subsidize CHFA senior-debt interest costs. No numeric rate_pct or remaining balance is published. CHFA must be senior lender.
restrictions: Interest support is an alternative use, not an additional $1 million award.

FHLB-TOPEKA-AHP.name: FHLBank Topeka Affordable Housing Program
FHLB-TOPEKA-AHP.description: Competitive AHP grant for eligible affordable housing through a participating member institution.

max_rule.text: No more than $1,500,000 per project and $75,000 per unit.

FHLB-TOPEKA-AHP.source_note: AHP is a grant, not interest-bearing project debt. rate_pct, term_years and repayment are null because the page does not publish a loan rate, loan term or one of the listed loan repayment structures; grant compliance and recapture rules still apply. Round opens July 1 and closes July 31, 2026; announcements no later than December 31. At least $29.3 million is a round allocation, not a current remaining balance.

pabVolumeCap.note: Colorado 2026 PAB volume cap. Updated quarterly from CHFA bond allocation reports. Projects must apply for PAB allocation before requesting 4% LIHTC determination.
